4 / Static Mermaid type gallery

Static Mermaid type gallery

The compile-time renderer also accepts these Mermaid types. They are shipped as sanitized light and dark SVGs with no Mermaid runtime in the review document. Every supported type has a stable figure anchor and footer target. Where Mermaid exposes identifiable static geometry, Big Plan also adds review targets: sequence participants and messages, class/state/ER nodes and labeled relationships, Gantt and journey tasks, pie slices, mindmap nodes, timeline events, and git graph commits. Flowchart and graph keep the richer semantic node/edge model; these static types derive anchors and accessible names from source labels and leave unlabeled geometry out of the review target set.

4.1 / Sequence

A sequence keeps the review handoff visible

4.2 / Class

A class diagram makes the compile boundary concrete

Class boxes are selectable. Unlabelled relationships remain visible in the static SVG, while the whole diagram and footer remain figure-level targets.

4.3 / State

A state diagram shows the review lifecycle

States are selectable. Unlabelled transitions remain visible in the static SVG, while the whole diagram and footer remain figure-level targets.

4.4 / Entity relationship

An entity relationship diagram shows review records

Entities and relationships are selectable; the whole diagram and footer remain available as figure-level targets.

4.5 / Gantt

A Gantt chart makes the delivery window legible

Gantt tasks are static SVG geometry; the whole diagram and footer are commentable.

4.6 / Pie

A pie chart shows where review effort goes

Pie slices are selectable; the whole diagram and footer remain available as figure-level targets.

4.7 / User journey

A journey follows a reviewer through the plan

Journey tasks are selectable; the whole diagram and footer remain available as figure-level targets.

4.8 / Mindmap

A mindmap groups the plan's source and output

Mindmap nodes are selectable; the whole diagram and footer remain available as figure-level targets.

4.9 / Timeline

A timeline records the renderer release

Timeline events are selectable; the whole diagram and footer remain available as figure-level targets.

4.10 / Git graph

A git graph shows the gallery branch

Commits are selectable. Unlabelled graph edges remain visible in the static SVG, while the whole diagram and footer remain figure-level targets.

ZenUML is intentionally shown as text rather than compiled: Mermaid 11.16.0 does not ship a ZenUML renderer, and Big Plan does not add a separate runtime.
